description: This file defines utility functions, macros, and constants for embedded firmware development, including endianness operations, string handling, mathematical functions, and cross-language compatibility interfaces.

methods.name: boolToString
methods.description: Converts a boolean value to its string representation ('true' or 'false').

methods.name: efiTrim
methods.description: Removes whitespace from the beginning and end of a string.

methods.name: mytolower
methods.description: Converts a character to lowercase.

methods.name: efiStrlen
methods.description: Returns the length of a null-terminated string.

methods.name: efiPow10
methods.description: Calculates 10 raised to the given integer power.

methods.name: startsWith
methods.description: Checks if a string starts with a specified prefix.

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence of a character in a string.

methods.name: atooff
methods.description: Converts a string to a float.

methods.name: atoi
methods.description: Converts a string to an integer.

methods.name: absI
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of a 32-bit integer.

methods.name: absF
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of a float.

methods.name: efiRound
methods.description: Rounds a float value to a specified precision.

methods.name: maxI
methods.description: Returns the maximum of two integers.

methods.name: minI
methods.description: Returns the minimum of two integers.

methods.name: maxF
methods.description: Returns the maximum of two floats.

methods.name: minF
methods.description: Returns the minimum of two floats.

methods.name: itoa10
methods.description: Converts an integer to a string in base 10.

methods.name: isSameF
methods.description: Checks if two floating point numbers are approximately equal.

methods.name: strEqualCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Compares two strings case-insensitively for equality.

methods.name: strEqual
methods.description: Checks if two strings are equal.

methods.name: limitRateOfChange
methods.description: Limits the rate at which a value can change over time.

methods.name: expf_taylor
methods.description: Approximates e^x using a 4th order Taylor expansion.
